messages.text: That's meaningful forward motion even if not fully clean — "waited too long but didn't hang forever" is a very different failure mode than "never fired at all," which is where every prior test sat. Sounds like Luma's fix moved the bug from "trigger completely missing" to "completion-detection timing is off," which is a much narrower thing to tune. Worth noting the actual delay length if you can estimate it — that'd help her figure out whether it's polling too infrequently, waiting on the wrong signal, or something else entirely.
